closedFindings.title: Executable identity gates replay input
closedFindings.result: Initial response tasks settle; all observed script/style responses must be successful and match the frozen dist/origin; every HTML-declared executable must be observed; recorded executable request failures reject input. The checks occur before replay file selection and Import click.

closedFindings.title: Final body-task intake is sealed
closedFindings.result: Body response listener is removed synchronously before counting/draining tasks. Late responses are status-only and cannot start body tasks or manifest writes. Every admitted task settles while Chromium is alive before browser close and final receipt serialization. Independent child static review agrees.
